ABSORCION: Draining is a stealing effect. When a Character drains something from a target, it means that the drained Character loses whatever is being drained, which is then given to the Character who is casting the draining effect. Draining Health is not the same as inflicting damage, so you cannot respond to this effect with Reactions.
ABSORBER_SALUD_X: Draining is a stealing effect. When a Character drains something from a target, the drained Character loses whatever is being drained, which is given to the caster. Absorbing Health {x} is not damage, so it cannot be responded to with Reactions.
AC_ALCANCE_DE_CUBO: CR (CUBE RANGE): This term refers to the Range of an effect, which is defined by the color of the cube spent to use the Skill or Reaction that cast it.
ACCION_DE_CUBO: CUBE ACTION: This is the name given to actions that a Hero takes by spending an Action Cube. During their turn, a Hero can perform up to two Cube Actions. Some special actions can be considered as one of these Cube Actions (e.g., purchasing an additional Move Action by Expending an AC). Reactions are not considered Cube Actions.
ACCION_DE_RECOBRAR_GRATUITA: FREE RECALL ACTION: A Free Recall Action is a Recall Action that can be taken without generating the Curse Cube penalty to the Hero who took it.
ACECHADOR: STALKER (TRAIT): Some killers specialize in using stealth to their advantage. As long as the Stalker Skill is not blocked, whenever the Slayer's Stealth fades away (i.e. is removed on its own at the beginning of its Hero's turn), the Slayer remains Hidden until the end of the current Hero's turn or until they try to surprise another Character.
ACTIVAR: ACTIVATE: Activate is the instruction to take a turn. When you Activate a Monster, for example, you take a turn with that Monster. When a Character is activated, its Conditions trigger at the beginning of the turn, then its Triggered Abilities fire, and finally it takes a Movement Action and/or an Attack Action. For Pets, when activated, you may choose to Summon them adjacent to their Master instead.
ACUMULABLE: STACKABLE: The Stackable property means that a Character can hold up to four copies of a same token on their boards/cards. A two-sided token displaying 1 and 2 is counted as individual tokens. Any fifth token of a Stackable effect received is ignored.
ADYACENTE: ADJ OR ADJACENT: Squares are adjacent if they share a line or corner between them. If tied to an effect, it can only affect a target in an adjacent square to the casting Character, regardless of the Skill's Range.
ALCANCE_X: RANGE X: Range is always counted using areas (blue squares). Range 1 can target any square inside a blue area up to 1 area away, Range 2 targets up to 2 areas away, and so on.
ALIVIAR_X: MENDING X: Monsters with this ability are field doctors. When triggered, another weaker Monster (lowest Health at the time within Range 1) regains X Health (up to its maximum). A Monster cannot use Mending on itself if no other Monster is within Range 1.
AMENAZA: THREAT: Threat defines the moment when a Hero can have their Health points reduced by some attack or effect, but is able to defend themselves and try to prevent it (triggering a Reaction Â³). Non-preventable damage never generates a Threat.
ANDANADA_X: MULTISHOT X: A Character with this ability fires a single ranged attack at X different targets within range. It inflicts damage normally to all targets hit with a single attack roll (if the attacker is a Hero).
APARTAR: SHOVE: When two Characters would occupy the same space and one has priority, the first shoves the second to a square adjacent to the area (blue square) previously occupied. The Party Leader chooses where a Monster is shoved; a shoved Hero chooses their own new position.
APORREAR: BASH: Bash is a trait characteristic of the Hero Andreas. Whenever a Skill has Bash, when resolving the effect containing Bash, you may discard 2 Shield tokens to add the effect described between Â«[]Â» to your Skill resolution.
ARROLLAR_X: TRAMPLE X: Trample is a movement improvement allowing a Character to pass through (but not end movement on) squares occupied by enemies, dealing X non-preventable damage to each enemy passed through once per move effect.
ASESINAR: SLAYER: A Monster with this ability will chase Injured NPC tokens, Cohorts, and Followers as their Primary Target, in that order of preference. If none are present or in reach, its Primary Target shifts to the Strongest Hero.
ATAQUE_CON_ARMA: WEAPON ATTACK (Â²): This Skill is an attack using your Weapon. You must roll the D20 to see if the attack is successful or a failure. Weapon Attacks can score Critical Hits and Critical Failures.
ATAQUE_CON_HECHIZO: SPELL ATTACK (Â¹): This Skill is a magic spell or ability that inflicts damage. This type of damage is always a success, so no attack roll is neededâ€”the target simply suffers the effect.
ATAQUE_DOBLE: ATTACK TWICE: A Monster with this ability, when activated, will make its move and then attack two times (it won't move twice or move between attacks). Each attack is resolved separately and can be interrupted or reacted to individually.
ATURDIMIENTO: STUN: When Stun resolves at the beginning of a Monster's turn, it loses its Attack Action for that turn and removes the Stun token (it still moves). At the start of an affected Hero's turn, they lose one of their two Cube Actions for that turn and remove the token. Stun is redundant.
AURA: AURA: An Aura is a story reward conferring special abilities. A character can only have 1 Aura recorded in their Campaign Log; it is replaced when receiving a new one or removed when knocked out and gaining a Trauma Cube.
AURA_SOMBRIA: SHADOW AURA: Whenever a Character suffers Shadow Aura, if they are not on top of Darkness, they spawn a Small Darkness tile in their square under their model.
EVITAR: AVOID: "Avoid" is used to indicate that you do not suffer some effect, much as PREVENT would, but since PREVENT is a specific Keyword, Avoid serves as a distinct non-keyword clarification.
BOT: BOT (BEGINNING OF TURN): Abbreviation describing the start-of-turn timing window when special abilities trigger, right after suffering start-of-turn Condition effects.
BOTIN: BOUNTY / LOOT TOKENS: Replaces and updates "LOOT". When a Monster is defeated by an attack with Bounty, it drops a Loot token. A Hero can collect it with a Minor Action to draw a Chest card without rolling the Trap Die.
BRUJO: WARLOCK (TRAIT): As long as the Otherworldly Pact Skill is not blocked, Warlocks receive Curse Cubes as Action Cubes, which are treated as Wild Cubes when spent. Once spent, they become conventional Curse Cubes again.
BRUTAL: VICIOUS / BRUTAL: The damage dealt by this Monster's attack is non-preventable.
CANALIZAR: CHANNEL: As long as a Skill with Channel has an Action Cube occupying its slot, the passive bonus described in "Channel - Effect" takes effect as a Passive Skill until the Action Cube is recalled.
CANCELAR: CANCEL: Associated with Interrupts ( Â¬ ). When an attack is Canceled, it no longer exists and deals no damage to any of its targets.
CARGAR: CHARGE: Whenever a Monster with this ability moves 3 or more squares to reach its target, double the base damage value of its attack.
CATALIZAR: CATALYZE: The next Action Cube the Hero uses this turn is treated as a Wild Cube (doubling numerical values on Hero Skills).
CEGUERA: BLINDNESS: The Character takes a Blind token. While holding it, they automatically miss any Weapon Attack if the natural d20 roll is 10 or lower. Lasts until a Recall Action or Cleanse effect.
CODICIA: COVETOUS: A Monster with Covetous targets the Hero holding the most Resource tokens (Focus, Shield, Ki) as its Primary Target. Ties are broken by fastest Initiative.
COLERA: ENRAGE: Whenever a Monster with this ability as Collateral Damage reduces a Character's Health or removes an allied character, it gains a +1 DMG token.
COMPANEROS: COMPANIONS: Companions have Sturdiness instead of Health (defeated only if single-hit damage exceeds Sturdiness). They activate after their Hero's turn with Move and Attack actions, and depart during Camp Phase.
CONCENTRACION_X: FOCUS X: The Target gains X Focus tokens to spend on Focus Abilities. Focus is a stackable resource.
CONSECUENCIA: CONSEQUENCE: A story status recorded in the Campaign Log from major player choices, influencing future interactions until explicitly removed.
CONSUMIR: EXPEND: Move an available Action Cube to the Expended box. An Expended AC can be recalled as normal but cannot be spent on Skills while there.
CONTRAATAQUE_X: COUNTER X: Whenever a Hero misses a Weapon Attack against a Monster with Counter X, the Monster deals X non-preventable damage to all adjacent enemies.
CONTROL_MENTAL: MINDLOCK: While a Monster with Mindlock is on the board, no Hero can spend blue Wisdom Action Cubes to use Skills.
CONTROLAR_UN_DRAUGR: COMMAND A DRAUGR: Activate a Draugr of your choice already on the board. Unlike other Pets, Draugrs cannot be summoned via Command.
CONTROLAR_UNA_MASCOTA: COMMAND A PET: Activate a summoned Pet already on the board to perform a Move Action followed by an Attack Action. Cannot be used to summon a Pet.
COBERTURA: COVER: A Character with Cover adjacent to an attacked ally redirects that attack to themselves, becoming the new target.
CRITICO_X: CRIT X+: Rolling X+ on a d20 attack roll scores a Critical Hit (double damage). Note: CRIT 16+ is renamed KEEN in the second generation.
SAGAZ: KEEN: Replaces the keyword CRIT 16+. Rolling a natural 16 or more on the d20 during an attack roll scores a Critical Hit.
CUBO_COMODIN: WILD CUBE: An Action Cube used as any color. When spent on a Hero Skill, any numerical values in its effect are doubled.
CUBOS_DE_ACCION: ACTION CUBES (AC): The colored cubes spent by Heroes to use their Skills.
CUBOS_DE_MALDICION: CURSE CUBES (CC): Black cubes representing corruption allocated to block Skill slots. Receiving a 6th CC results in corruption and party failure.
CUBOS_DE_TRAUMA: TRAUMA CUBES (TC): Represent deep wounds blocking Skill slots. Receiving a 2nd TC results in Hero death and adventure failure.
DANO_X: + or -X DMG: Added to or subtracted from attack damage. Critical Hits and Double Damage also double this bonus value.
DERRIBO: KNOCK DOWN: Target receives a Knock Down token. Cancels its next Move effect and is then removed. Redundant condition.
DESAFIO: DEFIANT: A Monster with Defiant targets the Most Vigorous Hero (most available Action Cubes) as its Primary Target.
DESARME: DISARM: Hero immediately Expends all available Melee and Ranged Action Cubes. Counted as Fatigue.
DESCARTAR: DISCARD: Resource loss. Remove the specified item/token from your board.
DEVORAR: DEVOURER: Prioritizes Injured NPC tokens. Attacking one slays it and transforms the monster into a Ravenous Abomination with +12 HP.
DIVIDIR: SPLIT: Allows splitting the effect among multiple valid targets (each receiving at least 1 point). Bonuses apply to total value before split.
DRAUGR: DRAUGR: Undead Pets raised by Necromancers. Activate after master's turn and require Taint to sustain.
EFECTO_DE_COPIA: COPY EFFECT: Copies all effects of another Hero Skill using its original base Range regardless of cube color spent.
EFECTO_DE_COPIA_COMODIN: WILD COPY: Applies the same effects as Copy but doubles all numbers written in numerical form as if cast with a Wild Cube.
ELEMENTO: OBJECT: Any component placed on the map boards (Characters, Furniture, Tokens). Divided into Movable/Immovable and Ground/Solid.
ELEMENTOS_SOLIDOS: SOLID OBJECTS: Map objects that block movement. Characters cannot end movement on them or pass through enemy solid objects.
EMBATE_X: STRIKE X: Area effect targeting X blue areas within range, affecting chosen characters inside those areas.
EMBOSCADA: AMBUSH: Monster is removed from board and placed in an unoccupied square adjacent to its Primary Target.
EMPUJON_X: PUSH X: Pushes target X squares away in a straight line until target reaches distance or hits an obstacle.
EMPUÃ‘ADURA_PESADA: HEAVY WIELD: Hard-to-handle weapons. Allows making only a single Weapon Attack per attack action taken or received.
ENCADENAR: CHAIN-UP: At turn start, targets non-adjacent Strongest Hero within Range 1, dealing 2 non-preventable damage and dragging them adjacent.
ENEMIGO: ENEMY: Any character not in the Hero party and not an NPC token.
ENERGICO: FINE: Character currently having half or more of their maximum Health (rounded up). Opposite of Wounded.
ENJAMBRE: SWARM: Tiny creatures suffering only half damage (rounded up, after Prevent) from all Weapon Attacks.
ENTROPIA: ENTROPY: Stackable resource for spellcasters. Discarding 4 grants an extra Cube Action or an extra Reaction.
EOT: EOT (END OF TURN): The final timing window of a turn right before advancing initiative, triggering end-of-turn effects.
ESCUDO_X: SHIELD X: Target gains X Shield tokens. Each absorbs 1 damage. Must be used before losing Health or using Prevent. Stackable.
ESTADO: STATUS: Campaign log story status or condition cleared during the Camp Phase.
EVOLUCION: EVOLVE: Monster permanently gains +2 DMG and +1 MOVE tokens on the Monster Status board.
FATIGA_X: FATIGUE X: Hero immediately Expends X available Action Cubes without effect.
FIRMEZA: STURDINESS: Companion damage threshold. Single hits equal to or less than Sturdiness are completely ignored.
FRAGIL: BRITTLE: Next damage suffered is doubled (or turns hit into a Critical Hit for Monsters) and removes the token.
FRAGMENTO_DE_ALMA: SOUL SHARD: Consumable resource token discarded as a Minor Action to give Double Damage to the next attack.
FRUTO_DE_VIDA: FRUIT OF LIFE: Consumable item discarded as a Minor Action to Heal 2 Health without taking bag space.
FURIA: FURY: Stackable resource. Discard 1 Fury token upon hitting to add +1 DMG to the attack.
GASTADO: SPENT: Condition of an Action Cube when allocated to a Skill slot.
GOLPE_DE_GRACIA: KILLING BLOW: The specific attack responsible for defeating a Monster and removing it from the board.
GRITO_DE_GUERRA: WAR CRY: When activated, all other Monsters within Range 1 permanently gain +1 DMG.
GUARDIAN: WARDEN (TRAIT): Allows using "SELF" Interrupts and Reactions on adjacent allies when they are attacked.
HECHIZAR: CHARM: Control an enemy Monster's turn to make it attack allies or walk into harmful terrain (deals half damage).
HEMORRAGIA_X: BLEED X: Target gains X Bleed tokens. At start of turn, takes 1 non-preventable damage per token and removes all tokens.
HENDEDURA_X: CLEAVE X: Attack targeting up to X enemies adjacent to the attacker with a single attack roll.
HERIDO: WOUNDED: Character currently having half or less of their maximum Health (rounded down).
HEROE_MAS_CANSADO: MOST TIRED HERO: Hero with fewest available Action Cubes (tie-breaker: slowest Initiative).
HEROE_MAS_CORRUPTO: MOST CORRUPTED HERO: Hero with most Curse Cubes (tie-breaker: fastest Initiative).
HEROE_MAS_DEBIL: WEAKEST HERO: Hero with lowest current Health (tie-breaker: slowest Initiative).
HEROE_MAS_FUERTE: STRONGEST HERO: Hero with highest current Health (tie-breaker: fastest Initiative).
HEROE_MAS_VIGOROSO: MOST VIGOROUS HERO: Hero with most available Action Cubes (tie-breaker: fastest Initiative).
HOSTIGAR: FLYBY: A Pet with Flyby freely returns adjacent to its master after making an attack.
IDOLOS: IDOLS: Sumonable magical objects providing special evoke powers to adjacent Heroes spending resource tokens.
IDOLO_DE_RESISTENCIA: IDOL OF ENDURANCE: Evoke power: SELF, HEAL 2.
IDOLO_DE_FURIA: IDOL OF FURY: Evoke power: SELF, next attack gains +2 DMG.
IDOLO_DE_TORMENTA: IDOL OF STORM: Evoke power: RANGE 1, 2 Spell Damage.
IDOLO_DE_TRANQUILIDAD: IDOL OF TRANQUILITY: Evoke power: SELF, CLEANSE 1.
IDT: BOT: Spanish abbreviation for Beginning of Turn.
IMPACTAR_X: + or -X HIT / +X TO HIT: Accuracy bonus/penalty added to a Weapon Attack roll (does not change natural Crit threshold).
IMPLACABLE: RELENTLESS: Monster targeting the Most Tired Hero as its Primary Target.
INFLIGIR: INFLICT: Applying an effect or condition directly without generating a Threat or allowing Reactions.
INMUNIDAD: IMMUNITY TO CONDITION/EFFECT: Character cannot be affected by or receive tokens of the specified Condition/Effect.
INSPIRAR: INSPIRE: Grants an Inspiration token allowing a Hero to reroll any d20 roll just made.
INTIMIDAR_X: INTIMIDATE X: Character suffers -1 DMG per Intimidate token. All tokens are removed after their next attack. Stackable.
IRA: MANIFEST EFFECT: Applies a special effect based on the color of the manifested Rune.
KI: KI: Stackable resource. Discarding 1 Ki allows making a +0 HIT Weapon Attack as a Minor Action.
LENTITUD: SLOW: Target loses 2 movement points from its next Move effect and removes the Slow token. Redundant.
LEVANTAR_UN_DRAUGR: RAISE A DRAUGR: Places a loyal Draugr in an adjacent unoccupied square (does not act immediately).
MALDICION_X: CURSE X: Target receives X Curse Cubes allocated to their skill slots.
MANDO: COMMAND: Monster immediately activates the Strongest non-Boss Monster to take a turn.
MANIFESTAR: MANIFEST: Randomly reveal a Rune from the bag to trigger a color-based effect, then return it to the bag.
MARCA_DE_MONTARAZ: RANGER'S MARK: Marked target suffers +1 DMG from all attacks made by the Ranger.
MASCOTA: PET: Special companions with their own status cards activating after their master's turn.
MATANZA: SLAUGHTER: Monster targeting non-companion/pet NPC Tokens as its Primary Target.
MONSTRUO_GRANDE: LARGE MONSTER: Immune to Knock Down, Push, Stun, Polymorph, and Telekinesis.
MOVER_X: MOVE X: Target may move up to X squares following standard movement rules.
MOVER_MAS_X: +X MOVEMENT: Grants X extra movement points whenever receiving a Move effect.
NO_DISPONIBLE: UNAVAILABLE: Resolution status indicating it can no longer be chosen in an interaction.
NO_MUERTO: UNLIFE: Trait of undead Pets requiring master to take a Curse Cube (Taint) at turn start to prevent dismissal.
NO_PREVENIBLE: NON-PREVENTABLE: Damage that cannot be reduced by Shields or Prevent and generates no Threat.
NOQUEAR: KNOCK OUT: Hero is immediately knocked out as if reduced to 0 HP, taking a Trauma Cube.
OBJETIVO_PRINCIPAL: PRIMARY TARGET: The priority character a Monster seeks to attack on its turn.
PAGA_X_SALUD: PAY X LIFE: Health loss (non-preventable) required before resolving a Skill's remaining effects.
PASIVA: PASSIVE: Ability continuously active unless blocked by a Curse or Trauma Cube.
PENITENCIA: PENITENCE: Target suffers 1 non-preventable damage per Curse Cube it holds.
PERMUTAR: SWAP: Two Movable Objects instantly trade positions on the board.
PERSONAJE: CHARACTERS: Heroes, Monsters, Pets, NPCs, and Companions.
PERSONAL: SELF: Skills/effects that can only target the casting character.
PIEL_GRUESA: THICK SKIN: Reduces damage from attacks and reactions by 1 point. Condition damage is unaffected.
PNJ_FICHA: NPC TOKEN: Solid movable tokens representing non-player story characters.
POLIMORFISMO: POLYMORPH: Replaces target model with a capybara using the Errant Behavior deck on turn start. Breaks if targeted by enemy attack.
POLIMORFISMO_SIMPLIFICADO: SIMPLE POLYMORPH: Optional rule without deck. Polished target takes no action and rolls d20 (11+ frees target, 10- stays polymorphed).
POTENCIAR: EMPOWER: Grants +4 DMG to the next single Weapon or Spell Attack made this turn.
PREVENIR_X: PREVENT X: Immediately reduces/ignores up to X damage dealt to the target.
PROTEGER: PROTECT: Adjacent character redirects an incoming attack on an ally to themselves.
PURIFICACION_X: CLEANSE X: Removes up to X Curse Cubes or Condition stacks (also clears all Poison).
QUEMADURA_X: BURN X: Target receives X Burn tokens. At start of turn, takes 1 non-preventable damage per token and removes 1 token.
REACCION: REACTION (Â³): Skill used in response to a Threat (preventable damage taken).
REAPRENDER: RELEARN: Campaign character progression process replacing learned Skills or Role choices.
RECIBIR: TAKE: Descriptive term for acquiring damage, conditions, or Curse Cubes.
RECOBRAR_X: RECALL X: Returns up to X spent or expended Action Cubes to the available box.
RECOMPENSA: BOUNTY / LOOT: Collateral damage effect causing a slain monster to drop a safe Loot token.
RECUPERAR_EL_ALIENTO: RECOVER BREATH: The action/moment of recovering from being knocked out.
RECUPERAR_X_SALUD: REGAIN X HEALTH: Target recovers X Health up to maximum (not modified by Heal bonuses).
REDIRECCION: REDIRECT: Redirects an incoming attack onto another character without generating extra threats.
REDUNDANTE: REDUNDANT: Character can hold only 1 token of this specific effect; additional tokens are ignored.
REGENERACION_X: REGENERATION X: Character regains X Health at the start of their turn up to maximum.
REPETIR_TIRADA: REROLL: Grants one free d20 reroll on a missed Weapon Attack made with that skill.
REPRESALIA_X: RETALIATE X: Immediately inflicts X damage back to the attacker.
RESTRICCION: RESTRAIN: Target receives a Restrain token and cannot leave their square while enemies with Restrain are within Range 1.
RESUELTO: RESOLVED: Game state indicating an effect or interaction has completed resolution.
RETROCEDER: PUSHBACK: Monster push effect forcing the targeted character back 1 square away from the source.
ROMPECRANEOS: SKULL-CRACKER: Attacks automatically pierce companion Sturdiness values, slaying allies outright unless damage is reduced to 0.
RONDA: ROUND: Time frame from the first initiative turn until the Rune turn resolves.
SALTO: JUMP X: Special movement ignoring terrain and enemies jumped over and preventing falling damage.
SANAR_X: HEAL X: Target regains X Health up to maximum.
SANGUINARIO: BLOODSEEKER: Monster targeting the Weakest Hero (lowest current Health) as Primary Target.
SAQUEO: LOOT: Collateral damage effect replacing a defeated enemy with a safe Chest token.
SIGILO: STEALTH: Target receives a Stealth token becoming hidden. Attacking grants Double Damage (Surprise) and removes stealth.
SILENCIO: SILENCE: Hero immediately Expends all available Agility and Wisdom Action Cubes (counted as Fatigue).
SOBREPRESION: OVERPRESSURE: Prevents Heroes from taking Minor Actions except consuming potions while this monster is on the board.
SUFRIR: SUFFER: Losing Health or taking conditions after attempting mitigation via Prevent/Shields.
TELEQUINESIS_X: TELEKINESIS X: Moves any small solid object up to X squares (falling from level 2 deals 2 non-preventable damage).
TERRENO_DIFICIL: DIFFICULT TERRAIN: Reduces current movement effect by 1 point (applies once per turn).
TIRADA_X: ROLL X+: Triggered benefit when rolling X+ on the d20 during an attack roll.
TODO: PREVENT ALL DMG: Prevents damage equal to the total incoming damage dealt to the target.
TRAMPA: TRAP: Area token triggering when an enemy enters or activates in the area.
TRAMPA_PARA_OSOS: BEAR TRAP: Deals 2 non-preventable damage and Bleed 2 when triggered.
TRAMPA_INCENDIARIA: FIRE TRAP: Deals 2 non-preventable damage and Burn 4 when triggered.
TRAMPA_VENENOSA: POISON TRAP: Deals 2 non-preventable damage and Poison 2 when triggered.
TRUCO_O_TRATO: TRICK OR TREAT: Tharmagar activation: Hero within Range 1 gains Heal 2, or Monster suffers Bleed 2, Burn 2, or Poison 2.
TURNO: TURN: Individual time window in which a character acts on the Initiative Track.
UNICA: UNIQUE: Story-bound Pet that cannot be summoned by generic pet skills.
USAR: CAST / USE: Expending cubes or activating abilities to apply effects to the game board.
VENENO_X: POISON X: Target gains X Poison tokens taking 1 non-preventable damage per token at turn start. Not removed by dealing damage (requires Cleanse).
VENGATIVO: RECKONER: Monster targeting the Most Corrupted Hero as Primary Target.
VERSATIL: VERSATILE: Double-sided equipment card that can be flipped over as a Minor Action when unblocked.
VORAGINE: MAELSTROM: Overlord ability: reshuffles attack deck and draws a new hand upon activation.
VUDU: VOODOO: Monster redirects incoming stackable conditions to the strongest enemy within Range 1 at turn start.
